title: Monument armor
wikitext:
[[Monument armor]] can be crafted by [[Brett]] in the [[Eye of the North (outpost)|Eye of the North outpost]], after reaching rank 5 (Shadow Agent) in the [[Ebon Vanguard rank]] title track.
